set.body: Reproduced with real CC0 ds000001 MNI2009c derivative corpus after BIDS4s metadata repair and complete participants table: all12 selected runs fail no matching events because derivative run-1 differs from raw run-01. BidsStudyCompiler.companionMatches uses exact raw string equality. Owner ScalaFIM workflow compiler consuming BIDS4s semantic index comparison; do not create application-local matching or rename sources. Preserve label entities (subject01 is not subject1), reject ambiguous numeric-equivalent companions, preserve original artifact names and explicit run IDs. Add small JVM/JS compiler cases plus real four-participant three-run downstream proof. Consumer plsneuro issue bd-01M1VJB639V2PT8SWZAVCNG06D and /private/tmp/plsneuro-ds000001-discovery-3.json. General BIDS index semantics belong in BIDS4s.
